pr_title: conf/conf_sap.c: correct return of ossl_config_int() in UEFI system
pr_body:
FIX: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/issues/21299

ret in ossl_config_int() only used to check return value of CONF_modules_load_file(), should set it to 1 if in UEFI system.

issue_context.title: The first evp_generic_fetch() always fail in UEFI sys due to wrong return of ossl_config_int()

review_comments:
This might read better as

```
#ifdef OPENSSL_SYS_UEFI
    ret = 1;
#else
    ret = CONF_modules_load_file(filename, appname, flags);
#endif
```
(I will add my approval, but if you want to update this, happen to re-review then)
I prefer the common code being first.
